scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the hero section displays product name, logo, tagline, and primary call-to-action elements correctly (REQ-1, US-1)

steps.description: Open the landing page in a browser
steps.context: Fresh page load with no cached content

steps.description: Check that hero section is visible above the fold
steps.context: Standard desktop viewport (1280x720)

steps.description: Confirm presence of product logo, headline, subheadline, and CTAs
steps.context: Hero section should contain animated logo.gif from assets directory

test_cases.expected: Hero section is present with product name 'MirDB' visible

test_cases.input: Check for logo element with src containing 'logo.gif'
test_cases.expected: Logo image element exists and loads successfully
Button with text 'Get Started' or 'View on GitHub' is present and clickable
Link with text 'View Documentation' or similar is present
Subheadline mentioning persistence and memcached compatibility is visible above the fold

steps.description: Navigate past the hero section to the features area

steps.description: Check that 3-4 feature cards are displayed with proper content
steps.context: Each card should have an icon, title, and description

test_cases.input: Count feature card elements in features section
test_cases.expected: 3-4 feature cards are present

test_cases.input: Check for Memcached Protocol Compatibility feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card with title mentioning 'Memcached' and relevant description exists
Feature card mentioning 'Persistent Storage' or 'SSTables' exists

test_cases.input: Check for LSM Tree Architecture feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card mentioning 'LSM Tree' architecture exists

test_cases.input: Verify each feature card has an icon
test_cases.expected: All feature cards contain a visual icon or SVG element
